consent.title: Upload to a public temporary host
consent.why: Seedance only accepts reference videos by public URL. Local videos are uploaded to a third-party temporary host first, then the direct link is sent to BytePlus.
consent.public: The link is public: anyone with it can download the file, and it cannot be deleted early.
consent.expire: The link expires after about {{hours}} hours; tasks queued longer may fail (the task timeout has been shortened accordingly).
consent.noFace: Do not upload real faces, private, confidential or copyrighted content; Seedance 2.x also rejects real-face reference videos.
consent.alternatives: To avoid public upload: use your own video URL, an asset:// ID, or reuse a video generated in the last 24 hours.
consent.tooBig: Some files exceed this host's {{max}} limit; switch hosts or compress first.
consent.ack: I understand the risks and agree to upload

mcp.title: MCP (let agents use this app)
mcp.intro: Agents that support HTTP MCP (e.g. Claude Code) can connect with the command below; keep the app running.
mcp.agentIntro: Easier: just say the sentence below to your agent. It reads the local address and token itself, no token copying needed.
mcp.agentSentence: Follow {{url}} to install and connect the AI Video Platform MCP for me
mcp.rotateConfirm: The old token stops working immediately and connected agents must re-run the command. Continue?
mcp.note1: The command writes to ~/.claude.json (user scope), not to the project repo.
mcp.note2: Generation tools are billed; results include an estimated cost. Public upload of local videos needs allow_public_upload from the agent.
mcp.note3: The command sets a 10-minute timeout (timeout: 600000). generate_image waits up to 50 s by default and returns a task_id if not done yet; continue with get_task. A timed-out call is not a failure — do not resubmit.

endpoint.title: Endpoints (inference endpoints)
endpoint.hint: Manage BytePlus inference endpoints here: create, toggle the content filter, start/stop, rename and rate limits, delete. Requires an AK/SK (preferably a sub-account limited to ModelArk); stored only in the local keys.json and never shown in full.
endpoint.testOk: AK/SK is valid; the account has {{n}} endpoints
endpoint.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" ({{id}})? A running endpoint is stopped first; deletion cannot be undone and requests using it will fail.
endpoint.filterEditHint: Not in the API docs; verified: on = Default, off = Skip. Takes effect immediately and is read back after the change.
endpoint.rateLimitInvalid: Rate limit needs both RPM and TPM as positive integers
endpoint.name: Name
endpoint.filterOffHint: Off: sends Moderation.Strategy=Skip (not in the API docs, verified with the official CLI); baseline platform safety still applies
endpoint.noneForModel: No endpoint for this model yet; create one in Settings
endpoint.notConfiguredHint: Add an AK/SK in Settings → Endpoints to pick from a list; you can type an ID for now
endpoint.stopConfirm: Stop "{{name}}" ({{id}})? Requests using it will fail until it is started again.
endpoint.deleting: Stopping and deleting… (a running endpoint is stopped first; up to about 2 minutes)

quota.note: The response format is undocumented; field meanings are inferred from a real response. The MiniMax console usage bar is authoritative. Text / image / audio are limited by both the 5-hour and weekly windows; video only by the weekly window.
